questionText:
In a $B^+$- tree where each node can hold at most four key values, a root to leaf path consists of the following nodes:

$$A = (49, 77, 83, -), B = (7, 19, 33, 44), C = (20*, 22*, 25*, 26*)$$

The $*$-marked keys signify that these are data entries in a leaf.

Assume that a pointer between keys $k_1$ and $k_2$ points to a subtree containing keys in $[k_1, k_2)$, and that when a leaf is created, the smallest key in it is copied up into its parent.

A record with key value 23 is inserted into the $B^+$- tree.

The smallest key value in the parent of the leaf that contains $25*$ is ________. (Answer in integer)
explanation:
Step 1: Understand the given structure and path.
The path from root to leaf consists of:
• Node $A$ (Root/Internal): $(49, 77, 83, -)$
• Node $B$ (Internal child of $A$): $(7, 19, 33, 44)$
• Node $C$ (Leaf node child of $B$): $(20*, 22*, 25*, 26*)$

Step 2: Insertion of key 23.
Key 23 belongs to leaf node $C$ because $23 \in [19, 33)$.
Leaf $C$ currently has 4 keys: $(20*, 22*, 25*, 26*)$. Inserting 23 makes it overflow with 5 keys: $(20*, 22*, 23*, 25*, 26*)$.

Step 3: Splitting the leaf node.
The leaf node splits into two leaves:
• Left leaf $C_1$: $(20*, 22*, 23*)$
• Right leaf $C_2$: $(25*, 26*)$

The smallest key of the newly created leaf node $C_2$ is $25*$. As per the rule, $25$ is copied up to the parent node $B$.

Step 4: Updating parent Node $B$.
Node $B$ originally contains four keys: $(7, 19, 33, 44)$.
Inserting key $25$ into node $B$ causes an overflow in node $B$, giving five keys: $(7, 19, 25, 33, 44)$.

Step 5: Splitting the internal node $B$.
Node $B$ splits into two internal nodes:
• Left node $B_1$: $(7, 19)$
• Key pushed up to root $A$: $25$
• Right node $B_2$: $(33, 44)$

Here, leaf $C_2$ (which contains $25*$) points to the right subtree of $25$, which is managed by the newly created parent node $B_2 = (33, 44)$.

Step 6: Finding the smallest key value in the parent of leaf containing $25*$.
The parent of the leaf node containing $25*$ is now node $B_2$, whose keys are $(33, 44)$.
Therefore, the smallest key value in this parent node is 33.
